programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Best friends Bodil and Isabel, apparently happily married, sneak off for secret affairs using each other as an alibi. But when Isabel is killed when they were supposed to have been together. Bodil gets caught up in her own web of lies.

programme.title: The Sorcerer And The White Snake
programme.desc: A master monk tries to protect a naive young physician from a thousand-year-old snake demon. A contest of psychic powers results in mayhem.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: During the Japanese invasion of China, a wealthy martial artist is forced to leave his home when his city is occupied. With little means of providing for themselves, Ip Man and the remaining members of the city must find a way to survive.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: A woman is raped and murdered during World War 2. Forty years later she returns to haunt her persecutors from the Tao Tao Mansion. A professor and his family move into the house, only to have the spirits take their son.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition, he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist: Chen Zhen
programme.desc: The year is 1917 and Chen Zhen, believed to be dead, returns to Shanghai under a false name. He joins a mob boss for info on the Japanese incl. a long kill list and at night fights the Japanese masked.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: An action-thriller centered on a vampire-like woman who eats the skins and hearts of her lovers.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: A young Chinese warrior steals a sword from a famed swordsman and then escapes into a world of romantic adventure with a mysterious man in the frontier of the nation.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: A rich playboy gets blown up by a gangster when he flirts with the gangster's wife. Through a series of circumstances, his professor makes him a synthetic body that allows him to change into anything he wants.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: The film's story unfolds in the fictional country of Laika and in Hong Kong, China. A police academy student who has not yet graduated, Ashan (played by Gu Bin), is tasked with a dangerous mission. He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the group's leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: A model (Joey Wong) gets raped by a photographer (Wilson Lam). Meanwhile, she falls out with her best friend (Carol Cheng) due to her boyfriend (Alex Man), who's a cop.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its “Cop Shop Babes” as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat – can they resolve the case?

programme.title: The Case Of Disappearances
programme.desc: When Qing Cheng was a teenager, he was attacked by an unknown mutant monster and lost his family and memory. He was regarded by the villagers as an ominous person who would bring disaster.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: In 1990s China, a northern cop joins forces with a local detective in the southern city of Binhai to track down a ruthless gang responsible for a string of violent robberies. A battle of wits ensues between law enforcement and criminals.

programme.title: Let's Have A Baby
programme.desc: A charming tale of child-creating complications, featuring a rare comedic performance by Alex Man Chi-leung.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident…

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: An imperial agent gets ridiculed for his various inventions, until his supportive wife encourages him to attend a conference, which's actually a trap to kill all the doctors serving the emperor, where his crazy inventions come in handy.

programme.title: Mother Vs Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in the past to kill the Dragon Master as she know that they were close friends back then.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: An actor tries to convince a lady to play Samantha in an adaptation of the classic TV series, but unbeknownst to him, she really is a witch!

programme.title: Hail The Judge
programme.desc: A judge tries to save a female innocent who's wrongly being accused for murder.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After ambushing and killing his rival, losing everything in the process, dispirited warlord Hou Jie turns to a Shaolin monastery seeking salvation.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: The film revolves around a woman in her late twenties who rediscovers her talent for boxing after a long hiatus. She unexpectedly meets her former boxing coach and the pair work together to help her reach the final rounds of professional boxing matches.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey: Cinderella
programme.desc: The convoluted continuation of the adventures of the time-traveling, now-human Monkey King, who attempts to fulfill his divine destiny.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his older brother Ma Tai Chueng arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Be-friending a powerful mobster Wing Jing is given his nightclub in return for saving Tam Sei’s life. Unfortunately, another Gangster wants the territory a well.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A Chinese spy who's been out of service for ten years whilst making a living as a butcher is sent to Hong Kong to locate a stolen Tyrannosaurus rex skull.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: The documentary highlights renowned Chinese Kung Fu masters in the film industry, showcasing Hong Kong's Kung Fu legacy over sixty years and capturing their daring lives.

programme.title: The Devil's Trap
programme.desc: A priest travels to investigate a miller suspected to be working with the devil.

programme.title: Old Henry

programme.title: The Rake
programme.desc: Brother and sister, Ben and Ashley, reunite 20 years after the murder of their parents to face the cause of their parents' death, a supernatural creature known as The Rake.

programme.title: Beneath Us
programme.desc: The American Dream becomes a nightmare for a group of undocumented day laborers hired by a wealthy couple.

programme.title: The Price We Pay
programme.desc: After a pawn shop robbery goes askew, two criminals take refuge at a remote farmhouse to try to let the heat die down, but find something much more menacing.

programme.title: Havenhurst
programme.desc: A troubled young woman takes up residence in a gothic apartment building where she must confront a terrifying evil.

programme.title: The Hatching
programme.desc: On the death of his father, Tim Webber returns to his childhood village in Somerset to find something sinister is disturbing the idyllic peace of the villagers.

programme.title: The Junkyard Dogs
programme.desc: Follows a dog who is a master escape artist, who must team up with his puppy pals to prevent their block from being robbed.

programme.title: American Muscle
programme.desc: After serving hard time for 10 years, an ex-con has 24 hours to take his revenge on those who put him in prison.

programme.title: Holy Ghost People
programme.desc: To find her sister, a young woman hires an alcoholic ex-Marine to help her infiltrate the Pentecostal Church of One Accord.

programme.title: Radioflash
programme.desc: When a nuclear device causes an electromagnetic pulse that kills power to more than 200 million people, a teenage girl must help lead her family to survival in a dark new world.

programme.title: The Room
programme.desc: In San Francisco, an amiable banker's seemingly perfect life is turned upside down when his deceitful fiancée embarks on an affair with his best friend.

programme.title: Damon's Revenge
programme.desc: A group of young adults spend the weekend at a friend's house by the lake. Joined by the local sheriff, the group encounters an escaped convict Native American chief, a copycat killer and the return of the terrifying masked stalker, Damon.

programme.title: Burial Ground Massacre
programme.desc: A group of college students spend a night at an old, eerie manor, only to realize that a terrifying stalker is watching their every move as he begins plans to repossess an ancient Native American artifact located inside.

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Tormented by his past, a garbage man named Clean attempts a quiet life of redemption. But, soon finds himself forced to reconcile with the violence of his past.

programme.title: The School
programme.desc: When a doctor looking for her missing child awakens to find herself in an abandoned school, she must survive the supernatural terror and face her own demons if she is to find the truth about where her son is.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: A British nurse escapes an attack on her outpost. Hunted by a German-led war party, and with help from local warriors, she embarks on an epic journey to save a neighboring outpost.

programme.title: Riot
programme.desc: Cop Jack Stone robs a Russian mob bank to end in the same prison as the mob boss killing Jack's wife. An inmate helps him as does a reporter. Lots of fights.

programme.title: Outlaws And Angels
programme.desc: When outlaws on the lam invade the home of an unsuspecting, seemingly innocent, frontier family to hide out for the night, an unexpected game of cat and mouse ensues, leading to seduction, role reversal, and ultimately, bloody revenge.

programme.title: In Isolation
programme.desc: Four friends wanted to get away in a remote country house but when a mysterious man turns up and telling tales of a city ravaged by a epidemic and the looters who have pursued him, the friends rally to help.

programme.title: The Courier
programme.desc: A specialist carrier is hired to deliver a mysterious case to the underworld's most dangerous hitman.

programme.title: Pups Alone
programme.desc: While everyone is away on a company ski trip, Robert's neighbor hires two inept thieves to steal his latest invention. The neighborhood dogs will use Robert's inventions to set up a house of horrors for the thieves.

programme.title: Born To Dance
programme.desc: Tu, an ambitious young man who dreams of being a professional hip-hop dancer. When his father issues an ultimatum, Tu decides that dance is his way out.

programme.title: Old Henry
programme.desc: A farmer takes in an injured man with a satchel of cash. When a posse comes for the money, he must decide who to trust. Defending a siege, he reveals a gunslinging talent calling his true identity into question.

programme.title: The Fourth State
programme.desc: A German journalist investigating the Russian secret service gets caught up in a terrorist plot in Moscow.

programme.title: Death In Texas
programme.desc: Just out of prison, Billy Walker returns to El Paso to find his mom dying of liver failure but low on the transplant list. However, the border offers other, darker options.

programme.title: Winter War
programme.desc: In 1939, two Finnish brothers are conscripted in the army to fight in the war between Finland and the Soviet Union.

programme.title: The Lurking Fear
programme.desc: When a TV crew shoots a reality show at an abandoned mental institution, they encounter a horde of demons, leading to a bloody fight for survival.

programme.title: American Rider
programme.desc: Two bikers head from L.A. to New Orleans through the open country and desert lands, and along the way they meet a man who bridges a counter-culture gap of which they had been unaware.

programme.title: No Visitors
programme.desc: Respected surgeon Lewis Cutterman hides a dark secret. His family drugs guests and slowly consumes them, harvesting organs to sell for desperate patients in a twisted family business.

programme.title: Resident Evil: Vendetta
programme.desc: Chris Redfield enlists the help of Leon S. Kennedy and Rebecca Chambers to stop a death merchant from spreading a deadly virus in New York.

programme.title: Envy

programme.title: Canda Empire
programme.desc: Sebuah Acara Komedi Bertemakan Kolosal, Memiliki Format Sketsa Komedi Dengan Latar Belakang Sebuah Kerajaan Bernama Canda Empire Yang Tengah Bergejolak Karena Raja, Mangkat. Hal Ini Membuat Sang Penerus (Megi) Galau Karena Dua Penasehat Utamanya (Sule Dan Jarwo Kwat) Selalu Berbeda Pendapat Yang Mana Hal Tersebut Juga Akan Menghasilkan Kelucuan. Program Ini Juga Menghadirkan Komedian Papan Atas Seperti Parto, Nunung, Azis Gagap, Dan Bintang Tamu Lainnya Di Setiap Episode.

programme.title: Ijin, Ndan !
programme.desc: Ijin, Ndan Adalah Program Crimetainment Yang Menggabungkan Informasi Seputar Kejahatan Dan Kriminalitas Dengan Sketsa Komedi Situasional Yang Berlatar Di Ruang Interogasi Atau Kantor Polisi. Dipandu Oleh Tiga Host Utama Yaitu Komandan Zack, Bro Dim, Dan Miss Binal, Setiap Episodenya Juga Menghadirkan Berbagai Cameo Menarik Seperti Tahanan, Petugas Kebersihan, Hingga Karakter Unik Lainnya Yang Menambah Keseruan. Dengan Gaya Penyajian Yang Ringan, Menghibur, Dan Penuh Humor, Ijin, Ndan Tetap Konsisten Menyampaikan Fakta Aktual Dan Pesan Edukatif Kepada Penonton, Menjadikannya Tontonan Yang Informatif Sekaligus Mengundang Tawa.

programme.title: Kokom (Kompilasi Komedi)
programme.desc: Program Yang Berisikan Kompilasi Video-Video Lucu Yang Viral Di Sosial Media.

programme.title: Cahaya Bagi Negeri
programme.desc: Sebuah Program Yang Membahas Berbagai Isu Hangat Yang Sedang Ramai Diperbincangkan Masyarakat, Dikupas Dari Sudut Pandang Spiritual Dan Nilai-Nilai Kerohanian.

programme.title: Movinesia
programme.desc: Sebuah Program Yang Menghadirkan Sederet Film Pilihan Untuk Menemani Aktivitas Anda Dengan Dimeriahkan Oleh Para Pemain & Artis Papan Atas Berbakat, Dengan Cerita Ringan Seputar Kehidupan Remaja.

programme.title: Ustadz On The Road
programme.desc: Program Religi Yang Dipandu Oleh Seorang Host Dan Ustadz Yang Akan Memberikan Kajian Islami Dengan Treatment On The Road Disertai Dengan Study Kasus. Pembahasan Dilakukan Sepanjang Perjalanan Menuju Lokasi Sesuai Agenda Harian Ustadz. Program Ini Akan Disajikan Secara Ringan Dan Menyenangkan.

programme.title: Robocar Poli
programme.desc: Robocar Poli Bercerita Mengenai Petualangan Tim Penyelamatan Brooms Town Dalam Menjaga Keamanan Kotanya. Beranggotakan Poli Si Mobil Polisi Yang Pintar, Amber Si Mobil Ambulance Yang Baik Hati, Heli Si Helicopter Yang Lucu, Dan Roy Si Mobil Kebakaran Yang Kuat, Tim Penyelamat Selalu Membantu Teman Temannya Dikala Dalam Kesulitan. Dibantu Oleh Jin Seorang Gadis Remaja Yang Selalu Bijaksana, Mereka Bekerja Sama Dan Membuat Kota Brooms Town Menjadi Kota Ternyaman Bagi Warganya.

programme.title: Bread Barbershop
programme.desc: Bread, Seorang Tukang Cukur Jenius, Memecahkan Masalah Penampilan Dengan Keterampilan Memotong Rambutnya Yang Briliant. Sekarang Dia Hadir Untuk Memecahkan Masalah Para Bintang Di Bakery Town. Bertentangan Dengan Penampilan Mereka Yang Glamor Dan Bersinar, Para Selebriti Ini Menjalani Hari Yang Sangat Suram. Bread Dan Keluarganya Siap Membantu Para Selebriti Untuk Menemukan Lagi Kebahagiaan Mereka.

programme.title: Will Sliney'S Storytellers
programme.desc: Menceritakan Petualangan Freya, Seorang Gadis Pembuat Peta Viking Yang Pemberani, Bersama Ogham, Sebuah Batu Melayang Ajaib Yang Jenaka. Mereka Mengemban Misi Perjalanan Lintas Waktu Untuk Mengumpulkan Tim Seniman Muda Berbakat Guna Menghentikan Penjahat Licik Bernama The Chronicle Dan Antek-Anteknya. The Chronicle Berencana Untuk Mencuri Dan Menguasai Seluruh Karya Seni Paling Terkenal Di Dunia.

programme.title: Adit Sopo Jarwo
programme.desc: Animasi Indonesia, Berisikan Kisah Kehidupan Sehari-Hari Masyarakat Indonesia Yang Dipenuhi Dengan Pengetahuan, Kelucuan, Kisah Persahabatan, Serta Nilai Persatuan, Kesatuan, Dan Kebudayaan.
